_comment: OpenClaw cron jobs for NexusOS. All jobs are disabled by default — enable per environment.

crons.description: Run AgentShield security scan on NexusOS repo and report findings
crons.instruction: Run a full AgentShield security scan on the NexusOS repository. Use ecc-agentshield in deep mode. Report: total issues by severity, any new CRITICAL/HIGH findings, and recommended fixes for the top 3 issues.

Generate a morning standup summary: (1) missions completed yesterday with outcomes, (2) missions currently active and their phase, (3) any missions awaiting my approval (HITL gates), (4) anything blocked. Keep it to <10 lines.

crons.description: Every 6 hours — check NexusOS repo health
crons.instruction: Check NexusOS repo health at https://github.com/Inmodel-Labs/NexusOS: (1) any failing CI runs, (2) open PRs older than 48 hours, (3) any stale branches, (4) dependency security alerts. Report only if issues found.

Generate a weekly engineering review: missions completed this week, code quality trends (test coverage, security findings), top 3 accomplishments, top 3 items to prioritize next week. Format as a concise report.
